topSlice.title: Soft-deleted accounts with surviving provider sessions retain member API access
topSlice.blast: When provider disable fails after the application soft-delete, existing sessions still read member profile data. The deletedAt login guard does not revoke sessions already signed in; shared getUser and GUC bootstrap also continue recognizing the identity.
topSlice.evidence: app/api/admin/members/[id]/delete/route.ts:100-118 explicitly retains deletedAt on Auth disable failure; lib/auth/server.ts:101-115 and :164-178 omit deletedAt; app/api/member/profile/route.ts:18-26 returns that deleted row; app/api/auth/login/route.ts:145-175 checks deletedAt only during login. Raw red regression: graph/evidence/clm_secrets_deleted_session_still_authorized.txt

topSlice.title: Logout returns success and retains authentication cookies on a provider sign-out error
topSlice.blast: Shared-browser logout can leave the previous member or staff session usable: the UI accepts HTTP 200 and redirects while both Supabase auth-cookie chunks remain.
topSlice.evidence: app/api/auth/logout/route.ts:30-51; components/portal/SignOutButton.tsx:20; installed @supabase/auth-js 2.101.1 src/GoTrueClient.ts:3730-3746 returns provider 503 before local session removal. Raw red regression: graph/evidence/clm_secrets_logout_retains_session.txt
topSlice.verify: npx vitest run --config graph/evidence/secrets-run_20260909_1730.vitest.config.mts -t 'logout clears local authentication'

topSlice.title: Enforced staff MFA permits admin API access before initial factor enrollment
topSlice.blast: A password-authenticated administrator can skip the setup-MFA destination and directly reach admin APIs before enrolling any factor. Role checks still apply, but the mandatory second factor is bypassed.
topSlice.evidence: middleware.ts:382-407 gates only aal1/aal2 and passes aal1/aal1; app/api/auth/login/route.ts:179-190 requires setup for unenrolled staff after creating their session; app/api/admin/members/route.ts:12-18 checks user/role only; installed @supabase/auth-js 2.101.1 src/GoTrueClient.ts:5442-5461 leaves nextLevel=aal1 when no verified factor exists. Raw red regression: graph/evidence/clm_secrets_mfa_unenrolled_admin_bypass.txt
topSlice.verify: npx vitest run --config graph/evidence/secrets-run_20260909_1730.vitest.config.mts -t 'enforced MFA rejects admin API'

topSlice.title: Milestone dispatcher persists sent status when every email fails
topSlice.blast: Approved learner celebrations leave the approval queue as sent even when the provider accepts no messages. Per-draft outcomes are returned but not persisted on the cascade, and the approve route only accepts awaiting_approval, so a failed send has no usable retry path through that endpoint. The separate exception path claims retryable while writing dispatch_failed, which is also rejected by that guard.
topSlice.evidence: lib/milestoneCascade/sendApprovedCascade.ts:89 counts failed emails, then :94-109 unconditionally writes sent/sentAt and swallows write errors. app/api/admin/milestone-cascades/[id]/approve/route.ts:95 rejects non-awaiting_approval statuses and :180-196 returns retryable:true for dispatch_failed. graph/evidence/clm_dead_milestone_20260909.txt records emailsSent:0, emailsFailed:1, persistedStatus:sent, persistedHasOutcomes:false under a synthetic provider rejection.

topSlice.title: Partner notification send paths ignore resolved provider errors
topSlice.blast: Partner milestone and new-member-assignment messages disappear when Resend resolves with {error}: both helpers return normally, do not enter their catch blocks, and bypass the central email failure diagnostic. Callers cannot identify or retry a rejected send. This affects course-completion and placement notifications as well as assignment updates.
topSlice.evidence: lib/notifications/partner-notify.ts:95 and :155 await resend.emails.send without inspecting its result; lib/email/send.ts:158 documents and handles this SDK error contract in the central wrapper. graph/evidence/clm_dead_partner_20260909.txt records two synthetic provider rejections, zero surfaced failures, zero logged errors. The probe loads the actual TypeScript module with isolated provider/DB mocks; no network.

topSlice.title: Deployment health returns HTTP success for a non-ready deployment
topSlice.blast: CronExecution records SUCCESS and external HTTP monitoring remains green despite the deploy health result being false.

topSlice.title: Inactivity outreach consumes the cooldown after a rejected email
topSlice.blast: Members miss the outreach email and become ineligible for retries for seven days; staff see a successful send.
